verdict.rationale: Figma documents API-driven automation: plan-scoped tokens intended for CI/CD and other non-user-gated tasks, a Variables REST API that integrates with CI to sync the design system, webhooks, and a remote MCP server that needs no desktop app. A Code Connect CLI also exists. Headless automation is still limited to these API and tool surfaces: the REST API mainly reads file contents, and plugins, the main way to write to the canvas, run only when a user invokes them in the editor. missing for 10: headless/CI execution of plugins or editor operations, a documented general-purpose CI runner or headless mode, broad REST write access beyond variables, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
